settings.scope: Prospectively frozen development evaluation on new synthetic parameter settings in the SAME known stable scalar law. Bounded-normal samples use rejection at 3 nominal sigmas; Gaussian samples are a separate bound-assumption stress condition. No real data, general dynamic safety, calibrated posterior theorem, novel method or independent publication test claim.

guard_config.scope: Standard finite-grid set estimation, cumulative damage guard, simple full-scan witnesses, and disagreement-based sequential design. Same known stable scalar law; synthetic zero/weak observations initialize all policies. Gaussian data can violate the assumed bounded error set. No continuous safety, real-world safety, new algorithm or novelty claim.
